text.body: || śaṃkarastotram || namastubhyaṃ bhagavate śaṃkarāya mahātmane| jagadutpattivināśānāṃ hetave mokṣahetave||1|| sarvadevādhidevāya pārvatīpataye namaḥ| ṛṣiyogimunīndrāṇāṃ tvameva paramā gatiḥ||2|| brahmāṃḍagolake deva dayālūnāṃ tvamagraṇīḥ| ata evolbaṇaṃ pītaṃ tvayā hālāhalaṃ viṣam||3|| gaṃgādhara mahādeva candrālaṃkṛtamastaka| parameśvara māṃ pāhi bhayaṃ vāraya vāraya||4|| sarvapāpaṃ praśamaya sarvatāpaṃ nivāraya| duḥkhaṃ hara harāśeṣaṃ mṛtyuṃ vidrāvaya drutam||5|| stutiṃ kartuṃ na me śaktistava vāggatyagocara| dehi satsaṃgatiṃ bhaktiṃ niścalāṃ tvayi śaṃkara||6|| sarvāriṣṭaṃ parihara sarvaśatrūnvināśaya| dāridryaṃ hara sarveśa sarvānkāmān prapūraya||7|| mukhe nāma dṛśo rūpaṃ hṛdaye tvatpadāmbujam| mamāstu te namaḥ sāṃba prasanno bhava sarvadā||8|| tvadarcanavidhiṃ jāne na bhaktistvayi me hṛdi| athāpyanugrahāṇeśa kevalaṃ dayayoddhara||9|| iti śrī pa. pa. śrīvāsudevānandasarasvatīviracitaṃ śaṃkarastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam||
